Among those aged 30 to 44, the 27 percent approval figure was outweighed by 70 percent disapproval. results.content: President Donald Trump’s approval ratings have collapsed to historic lows across the country, with a new YouGov and Economist projection showing negative net approval in 47 of the 50 states and the District of Columbia. Only three states—Wyoming, Idaho, and West Virginia—maintain majority approval of the president, according to the analysis released August 21, 2026. [...] Economic disapproval is equally severe. A June 2026 Economist/YouGov poll found that a record 63 percent of Americans disapprove of how Trump is handling the economy.
